Trump Draws Ire Over Calling Putin His 'Friend' as Europe-U.S. Rift Widens

President Donald Trump ’s warm greeting for Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in China Thursday has sparked concern and ire from some European lawmakers.
